thread:
jose: Quick sync: the v1->v2 migration guide still lacks clear guidance for SDK users that rely on automatic model-aliasing. We need a short section and a tiny code example showing how to pin model ids and fall back to aliases.

mei: Agreed. I saw a customer hit an issue where `model_alias` silently switched to the new default. Recommend we show both patterns and strongly advise pinning `model_id` for production.

olga: Draft snippet (JS):
```js
// safe: pin model id to avoid alias drift
client.generate({ model: 'redwood-chat-2026-04-05', input: 'summarize' })
// less safe: alias may change
client.generate({ model_alias: 'chat-stable', input: 'summarize' })
```

docbot: PR opened by jose: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/14022  title: "migration: recommend pinning model ids + alias guidance"  preview queued.

mei: Also include copy for account teams: short blurb explaining why pinning matters and how to opt-in to auto-updates if they want managed improvements. Legal asked for the opt-in wording.

jose: I'll add the opt-in snippet and a one-line explain of rollback steps if an alias update causes regressions (pin old id, rollback canary).

ci-bot: staging build started for PR 14022.

olga: One more: add a short test in the SDK smoke tests that verifies examples with `model_id` continue to work post-release; QA will catch code that still relies on aliases.

mei: I'll coordinate with QA to add that to the pre-release checklist.

jose: Pushed update: includes JS + Python pin examples, account-team blurb, and QA checklist.
